summary: Phase 51 KARTA ŽIVOTA — ALL GREEN on backend + frontend (mobile 390x844). Backend: 20/20 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_phase51_lifecard.py (pytest_phase51.xml, ~13s). Verified: GET /api/lifecard shape (full_name/birth_date/blood_type/age/counts{5cats}/predictions/today); PUT /api/lifecard persists birth_date (1958-05-14, age 68) + blood_type B+ into emergency_profiles (reflected via GET /api/emergency-profile); invalid blood XX+ → 400, birth 14-05-1958 → 400, 1899-01-01 → 400, future date → 400. POST /api/calendar/events creates all 5 categories (vaccine/disease/surgery/injury/exam) with title+date+notes, source='manual'; legacy 'history' aliases to 'disease'; invalid category → 400. GET /api/calendar/timeline returns counts for all 5 + supports ?category filter (no leaks). DELETE /api/calendar/events/{id} works + second delete → 404. Jarvis voice: POST /api/agent/chat 'Dnes mi doktor povedal, že mám ovčie kiahne' → lifecard_logged{category:'disease', date:today} + reply 'Zapísal som do Karty života…' + watermark; question 'Kedy mám ísť na očkovanie?' → NO lifecard_logged, normal chat reply with watermark. SSE /api/agent/chat/stream 'Včera mi lekár povedal, že mám angínu' → final data{done:true} contains lifecard_logged with valid category. POST /api/lifecard/predictions (LLM ~10s) → ai:true + validated predictions[] (category in vaccine|exam, suggested_date > today YYYY-MM-DD, reason non-empty, title non-empty). POST /api/lifecard/predictions/accept creates calendar_events with source='jarvis' + removes that prediction from GET /api/lifecard cache; invalid category → 400. Regressions PASS: pain 'bolí ma to na sedem' → pain_logged:7 + watermark; normal chat watermarked; /api/ips/summary returns 200/402 (no 500). Frontend (founder-bypass): /uzdravovanie shows gold hh-lifecard-hero at top (old hh-timeline tile GONE ✓); tap → /health-timeline → lc-identity renders 'Guardian Angel · 14. 5. 1980 · 46 r. · A+' in SK format; lc-edit reveals inline lc-name / lc-birth DateField / lc-blood-B+ chip / lc-save-card. ht-add opens quick add with all 5 chips (ht-cat-vaccine..ht-cat-exam); created injury via ht-cat-injury + ht-title + ht-date DateSheet day 15 + lc-notes + ht-save → appeared with ÚRAZ orange badge, popis in date row, ht-filter-injury count 'ÚRAZY (1)' + filters correctly; ht-del-{id} removes it. PREDIKCIE box: 1 prediction 'Preventívna prehliadka u všeobecného lekára 2028-09-04' with reason + 'AI Content · Sovereign Protocol' watermark; lc-accept-0 → lc-pred-msg = '✅ Pridané do Karty života.' + new '✨ PREDIKCIA' badge in timeline (PREHLIADKY count 5→6). lc-voice-hint navigates to /jarvis; sent 'Dnes mi doktor povedal, že mám angínu' via jv-input + jv-ask → 'Zapísal som do Karty života…' in ~2s; back on Karta života the CHOROBA angína record exists (ht-filter-disease visible). /calendar-sync loads without errors (Slovak native calendar screen renders — mobile-only permission message only appears after tap POVOLIŤ, expected on web). No React Native red screens; no console errors (only expected shadow*/pointerEvents/expo-notifications web warnings — pre-existing, not caused by phase 51).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/health.py KARTA ŽIVOTA block (lines 904–1125) is clean: LIFECARD_CATS tuple, BLOOD_TYPES tuple, Pydantic CalendarEventIn/LifeCardIn/PredictionAcceptIn with 140/500 char caps + regex/strptime date validation. Legacy 'history' MANUAL rows are lazily migrated to 'disease' at GET /api/calendar/timeline time (idempotent update_many).

PUT /api/lifecard correctly writes birth_date + birth_year to users (keeps Bio-Timeline in sync) and blood_type + full_name to emergency_profiles with upsert. Birth_date <1900 or > today → 400 as required.

POST /api/lifecard/predictions uses gpt-5.4 via emergent LLM, cache stored per user in db.lifecard_predictions, filtered server-side (suggested_date > today, category ∈ LIFECARD_CATS, YYYY-MM-DD regex), watermarked at UI. 502 on LLM failure — good.
POST /api/lifecard/predictions/accept inserts calendar_events with source='jarvis' + $pull the accepted prediction from the cached list — GET /api/lifecard no longer returns it (verified).

routes/agent.py _lifecard_trigger regex is cheap (300-char guard) and comprehensive (kiahn/chrípk/angín/covid/úraz/zlomil/…); LLM classifier returns {is_record,category,title,date,note} JSON, defaults date to today, rejects non-record → normal chat continues. Both /agent/chat and /agent/chat/stream (final `done` meta) surface lifecard_logged.
health-timeline.tsx uses DateField (no keyboard typing policy) — DateSheet exposes day cells as testID='{parent}-sheet-day-{d}' which is programmatically clickable in tests. Good.
health.tsx now leads with hh-lifecard-hero gold tile and old hh-timeline tile was removed. Confirmed via grep — no residual references.
AI watermark 'AI Content · Sovereign Protocol' consistently applied in chat replies + rendered as static text under PREDIKCIE card. Good compliance.
